fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Going Through the Body to Heal", "body": "Yerasimos argued that the mind and body are one, and that working directly through the body bypasses the stories and conditioning the conscious mind carries. He said deep pressure, breathwork and attention to sensation changed his own life more than books or talk therapy. Chance agreed that at a certain point people have to leave the conceptual and start feeling their actual energy in the body. They agreed that moving the body differently releases stored patterns and shifts thinking. Both stressed tuning into yourself, with Yerasimos saying that on questions like distilled water or food, the test was how you personally felt afterward, not what any guru claimed."}, {"title": "Parasites, Virology, and Disease Doubts", "body": "Chance said he had received a message from source and divination work that humanity was being asked to de-parasite, and he joked about political leaders as bloodsucking parasites. Yerasimos argued that virology was a pseudoscience and that germ theory was built on falsehoods. He recommended Virus Mania and the German New Medicine of Dr. Hamer, and said illness was an adaptive healing process. Chance said he had landed on nutritional deficiencies as what he saw as the real story behind many named diseases. These were their personal opinions, not established science, and no evidence was presented on air."}, {"title": "Habits, Pleasure, and the Shame Cycle", "body": "Yerasimos said he was not a fan of pornography and argued it harmed connection, intimacy and brain health. Chance added a metaphysical view, saying it shaped how men related to the divine feminine. Turning to food and other pleasures, Yerasimos argued that rigidity and food policing did not help and that guilt mattered more than the food itself. Chance said he liked staying unrigid, and that beating yourself up only reinforced the story behind the urge. Yerasimos urged looking at why anyone repeated a habit daily, including exercise, and asked what the person was running from."}, {"title": "Fun, Flow, and Trusting the Unknown", "body": "Chance argued that accidents and tragedies could be interruptions from forces trying to redirect someone stuck in work that was wrong for them, though he said he did not want to go full law of attraction. He asked what if life were for enjoyment and enlightenment, and said trusting the unknown led to synchronistic perfection. He said the ego did not need killing, only the voice demanding control. Yerasimos agreed that hard events invite self-inquiry, and argued that each person should find their purpose and pursue it fully while not taking themselves too seriously."}, {"title": "Esoteric Systems as Tools for Self-Knowledge", "body": "Chance played a video of an object he described as a possible UFO filmed near his home in Springfield, Missouri, and Yerasimos said he had never seen one himself. Yerasimos explained his birth card, the King of Clubs, in the playing card system, and walked Chance through Human Design, describing its blend of astrology, Kabbalah, the I Ching and chakras. He told Chance that they shared a five one profile, the heretic investigator. Chance argued that astrology's challenging aspects showed where a person's obstacles were, saying the obstacles are the course, and both called these systems useful information rather than final answers."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Yerasimos is a bodywork and health expert, coach and guide, who also hosts the podcast Here For the Truth with Joel Rafidi. And I wanted to talk about UFOs.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "My thing is you need to tune into yourself and your body as much as you can as opposed to like, well, what does this person think about this one subject? Sure, have distilled water, but do you drink it? How do you feel? Same thing goes with food. How do you feel after eating certain foods?", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "So very often our minds can get in the way of dealing with certain things in our lives. But if we go directly into the body, we're bypassing that conscious mind that has all those stories and all those things that we've been conditioned and believe. The body doesn't lie.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "That classic mindset that we're taught in the West of how you just gotta do stuff that sucks and do stuff you hate and then you'll be successful. And that is the biggest contradiction to what life is actually about that I've ever come across.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It wants you to do what's most right for you and fun and exciting for you at the same time. And when you get into the rhythm of just like not worrying about it and trusting it, you slip a few months down the line and you're like, oh wow, it's just been continually working out in synchronistic perfection without me needing to control anything.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When they say you need to kill your ego or whatever, I think that the caveat should be, you don't need to get rid of your individuated personality. You need to get rid of the voice that said, I need to control this because if I don't know exactly how it's all gonna go and plan out every detail, then it'll fall apart. That's the lie.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It's not about the thing that's happening. It's about how you're thinking about the thing that's happening as well that's gonna have an impact. It's the same thing before I said about the food. Someone can go out there and eat a piece of chocolate cake and be like, oh my God, I'm celebrating with my family, my friends, I feel great.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think that is more what life is about than we've ever given it credit for. What if this entire experience wasn't just a bit like a lesson or a purgatory or a punishment or a prison or all these things that were offered as like the meaning of life. What if everything that ever happens in your life is for your enjoyment and enlightenment?", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Whatever that is, whatever the seed of consciousness that you are, that God implanted onto this world. Figure out what that is, who you are, what your purpose is, what your mission is and do it to the full degree.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "What would happen if the person would say, hey, don't go to the gym today. Just sit there on the couch and close your eyes and see what comes up. You notice your thoughts and notice the feelings in your body, those kinds of things.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Wherever the obstacles are in the chart, if you go headlong into those and fearlessly approach the solution to those challenges, that is the first and best way to level up and get through stuckness in your life. I've been saying this a lot, but Inner Child loves obstacle courses. The obstacles are the course.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Human design is just another esoteric system. It's a system of knowledge that integrates four ancient sciences, the Western astrology, Kabbalah tree of life, the Chinese I Ching and a nine centered Hindu chakra system combined with an understanding of two modern sciences, neutrinos and the genetic code.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm here now. I think I've absorbed enough that it's all mixing around inside of me and what feels good is to see what comes out now instead of keep trying to cram more in.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Definitely gratitude is a big piece, even especially when I'm with people, but even on my own, it's like I just take a moment and just look down at my food and even if it's just within myself, a moment of just deep gratitude and connection to everything that played a role in getting this food and this nutrition and this nourishment to my plate.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
